notes.defaultVoiceId: Ariël, the Dutch voice of the lessons. Better: a native voice per language from the Voice Library (put its id in voiceId).
notes.model: eleven_multilingual_v2 (29 languages) knows ar, uk, tr, pl, ro, bg, es, pt, fr, de. Persian is only in eleven_v3. Tigrinya is in neither: a native speaker records it (docs/opnames.md).
notes.prs: Dari: no ElevenLabs model names it; eleven_v3 reads it as Persian. Let a Dari speaker listen before it goes live; if it sounds Iranian, record it by phone like Tigrinya.
